readiness.learningScope: Opt in for this account and direction only. Matches the complete counterparty account, or this payee when no reliable account is available.
readiness.roleImpact: Changes automatically derived report history. Explicit transaction flow choices and own-account transfers keep their meaning.
readiness.deleteBatchDescription: Delete {{count}} currently linked transactions from {{file}} ({{period}})? Other imports, separately changed balances and rules remain. This cannot be undone.
readiness.balanceEstimate: Estimated from the available booked ledger. Balance anchor: {{date}}. Statement coverage is not proven.
readiness.nativeOnly: Incoming/outgoing totals and chart use booked {{currency}} only. Foreign-currency movements are excluded.
readiness.oneTimeChoices: Preview choices apply to these rows only.
readiness.mappingHelp: Use a signed amount (+ incoming, − outgoing), or outgoing and incoming columns. The signed column wins if both layouts are selected.
readiness.provenanceMappingHelp: Balance keeps the dated statement anchor; bank transaction ID identifies certain duplicates. Currency defines native units. Value date is separate from booking date. Account identifier, bank code, country and pending status are optional; no missing bank code is guessed.
readiness.balanceBlocked: This statement balance uses different units or is older than the current dated anchor; it cannot replace it.
readiness.balanceConfirmDescription: Set {{amount}} as of {{date}}? Current balance date: {{currentDate}}. An unknown current date needs your explicit confirmation. The balance is separate from imported transactions.
readiness.aggregateFxWarning: Totals in {{currency}} exclude accounts without a known FX rate. Native account values remain below.
readiness.specificLearningScope: This account · {{direction}} · {{identity}}. Reliable accounts match across payee names; otherwise only this payee.
readiness.resultCategorized: {{count}} newly imported transactions have a category; {{open}} remain uncategorized.
readiness.flowUnresolved: Financial meaning has not been resolved.
readiness.deleteBatchDescription_zero: This import has no linked transactions to delete.
readiness.deleteBatchDescription_one: Delete {{count}} currently linked transaction from {{file}} ({{period}})? Other imports, separately changed balances and rules remain. This cannot be undone.
readiness.deleteBatchDescription_other: Delete {{count}} currently linked transactions from {{file}} ({{period}})? Other imports, separately changed balances and rules remain. This cannot be undone.
readiness.excludedForeign_zero: No foreign-currency movements excluded from native totals
readiness.excludedForeign_one: {{count}} foreign-currency movement excluded from native totals
readiness.excludedForeign_other: {{count}} foreign-currency movements excluded from native totals
readiness.advancedColumnsHelp: Optional. Map them only when the file has such a column; leave “not used” otherwise.
readiness.valueDateHint: Day the money actually moved. Stored next to the booking date; reports and duplicate checks use the booking date.
readiness.bankCodeHint: Bank code of a domestic account number, e.g. 0800. Needed to recognise transfers between your own accounts; a missing code is never guessed.
readiness.countryHint: Country of the counterparty account, e.g. CZ. Helps read domestic account numbers correctly.
readiness.statusHint: Values Pending, Booked or Completed; anything else is reported as an error. Pending rows are shown but stay out of reports until booked. Map it only when the file has a transaction ID – without one a pending row cannot be matched to its booked copy.
readiness.pendingDateHint: Date used for pending rows that have no booking date yet (e.g. the card payment start date).
